description: Programs that fail at run time.

cases.name: undefined-in-assignment
cases.description: Reading a variable that was never assigned.

cases.name: undefined-in-while-condition
cases.description: Undefined variable in a loop condition.
cases.source: begin while u > 0 do skip end

cases.name: undefined-in-if-condition
cases.description: Undefined variable in an if condition.
cases.source: begin if u > 0 then skip else skip end

cases.name: or-is-strict
cases.description: Both operands of '∨' are evaluated, as in the course semantics.
cases.source: begin if 1 = 1 ∨ u = 0 then skip else skip end

cases.name: undefined-after-progress
cases.description: The error is reported at the failing variable.

cases.name: step-limit-skip-loop
cases.description: Infinite loop stopped by the step limit.

cases.name: step-limit-assignment-loop
cases.source: begin x := 0; while x = 0 do x := 0 end
